risks.title: Quotes or tenders not evidenced for spend at or above the quote threshold
risks.statement: Suppliers whose annualised spend reaches the three-quote threshold should each be backed by a competitive process run through the Procurement Portal and by written evidence of the purchase [rule:CPR-56] [rule:CPR-33]. Where that evidence is missing, the purchase may not have followed the Rules.

likelihood.justification: {{$.tests.high_value_suppliers.headline_general_procurement.suppliers}} general-procurement suppliers have an annualised estimate at or above £{{$.tests.high_value_suppliers.parameters.threshold}} [metric:$.tests.high_value_suppliers.headline_general_procurement.suppliers], a pattern that recurs across many suppliers. The most recent Contract Letting audit gave Reasonable Assurance [history:AUD-08], so no uplift applies.

impact.justification: The annualised value exposed is £{{$.tests.high_value_suppliers.headline_general_procurement.annualised_estimate}} [metric:$.tests.high_value_suppliers.headline_general_procurement.annualised_estimate]. A competition rule breached on contracts of this size carries a reasonable possibility of successful legal challenge, the Medium compliance level of Table 1 [history:$.scoring_method.impact_scale[2]] [rule:CPR-56]. The compliance column drove the rating; the £ figure is spend exposed, not loss.

evidence: [metric:$.tests.high_value_suppliers.headline_general_procurement.suppliers] general-procurement suppliers at or above the quote threshold
risks.proposed_focus: For a sample of high-value general-procurement suppliers, obtain the quotation or tender record, the Portal invitations and the contract, or an approved waiver.

risks.title: Requirements split so each payment stays below the quote threshold
risks.statement: Several payments to one supplier within thirty days that together reach a competition threshold, while each stays below it, may indicate a requirement that was not aggregated before the procurement route was chosen [rule:CPR-14].

likelihood.justification: {{$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[0].headline_general_procurement.windows}} thirty-day windows across {{$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[0].headline_general_procurement.suppliers}} general-procurement suppliers reach £{{$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[0].threshold}} [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[0].headline_general_procurement.windows]. The published population omits payments below its transparency floor, so these counts are a lower bound.

impact.justification: The windows total £{{$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[0].headline_general_procurement.gbp}} [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[0].headline_general_procurement.gbp]. Disaggregation to avoid the three-quote route is a breach of a mandatory Rule with a reasonable possibility of challenge [rule:CPR-14] [history:$.scoring_method.impact_scale[2]].

risks.proposed_focus: For the largest general-procurement windows, obtain the orders and quotes and confirm whether the requirement was one purchase that should have followed the three-quote route.

risks.title: Payments bunched just below the quote threshold
risks.statement: Payments placed just below a threshold can indicate values set to avoid the next procurement route [rule:CPR-55] [rule:CPR-56].

likelihood.justification: {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[1].general_procurement.count}} general-procurement payments fall within ten per cent below £{{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[1].threshold}} [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[1].general_procurement.count], while {{$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[1].comparator_above.count}} payments sit just above it [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[1].comparator_above.count]. There is no bunching below the line, so the signal is weak.

impact.justification: A value set to avoid the three-quote route breaches a mandatory Rule [rule:CPR-56]; Medium compliance impact [history:$.scoring_method.impact_scale[2]].

evidence: [metric:$.tests.threshold_clustering.per_threshold[1].count] payments within ten per cent below the quote threshold
risks.proposed_focus: For the general-procurement payments just below the quote threshold, confirm the order value and that no related order was raised in the same period.

risks.title: High-value suppliers with no published contract notice
risks.statement: Spend at or above the quote threshold should rest on a contract notice published on the Central Digital Platform and on a contract recorded in the Council Contract Register [rule:CPR-56] [rule:CPR-36]. A supplier with no matching notice is an indicator to check against the register, not evidence of off-contract spend.

likelihood.justification: {{$.tests.off_contract.headline_unmatched_general_procurement.suppliers}} general-procurement suppliers above the threshold have no matching notice active in the spend window [metric:$.tests.off_contract.headline_unmatched_general_procurement.suppliers]. The signal is strong, but the notices file is not a register: older awards, framework call-offs and Find a Tender notices are missing from it, so many gaps can be legitimate [metric:$.contracts.active_in_window].

impact.justification: The unmatched suppliers account for an annualised £{{$.tests.off_contract.headline_unmatched_general_procurement.annualised_estimate}} [metric:$.tests.off_contract.headline_unmatched_general_procurement.annualised_estimate]. Missing publication and register records breach the transparency Rules with a reasonable possibility of regulatory interest [rule:CPR-08] [history:$.scoring_method.impact_scale[2]].

evidence: [metric:$.tests.off_contract.headline_unmatched_general_procurement.suppliers] general-procurement suppliers with no matching notice
[metric:$.contracts.active_in_window] notices active in the spend window
risks.proposed_focus: For the largest unmatched suppliers, request the Contract Register entry and the contract or framework call-off; confirm a notice was published where the Rules require one.

risks.title: Spend after a contract notice ended without an approved extension
risks.statement: Payments to a supplier whose every published notice ended before the spend window may indicate a contract extended without the S151 Officer's approval [rule:CPR-63]; a newer contract with no notice is also possible.

likelihood.justification: {{$.tests.expired_notice_spend.suppliers}} suppliers were paid after their only matched notices ended [metric:$.tests.expired_notice_spend.suppliers], a clear signal confined to a few suppliers.

impact.justification: The annualised spend involved is £{{$.tests.expired_notice_spend.annualised_estimate}} [metric:$.tests.expired_notice_spend.annualised_estimate]. An unapproved extension breaches Appendix C row D, with a reasonable possibility of challenge [rule:CPR-63] [history:$.scoring_method.impact_scale[2]].

evidence: [metric:$.tests.expired_notice_spend.suppliers] suppliers paid after their notices ended
risks.proposed_focus: For each supplier, obtain the current contract or the S151 Officer's extension approval, and the register entry.

risks.title: Spend running ahead of the awarded contract value without an approved variation
risks.statement: Annualised spend well above the annual rate of the awarded value may indicate a variation of scope that needed prior approval [rule:CPR-64]; award values can be estimates or maxima.

likelihood.justification: {{$.tests.spend_vs_award.flagged}} of {{$.tests.spend_vs_award.checked}} checkable suppliers show spend at or above the flag ratio of the award's annual rate [metric:$.tests.spend_vs_award.flagged], a clear signal confined to a few contracts.

impact.justification: The flagged suppliers account for an annualised £{{$.tests.spend_vs_award.flagged_annualised_estimate}} [metric:$.tests.spend_vs_award.flagged_annualised_estimate], within the Major financial band of Table 1 [history:$.scoring_method.impact_scale[1]]. Variations above the Threshold need board approval [rule:CPR-64].

risks.proposed_focus: For each flagged supplier, obtain the contract, any variation and its approval, and compare spend to date with the awarded value.

risks.title: Possible duplicate payments to the same supplier
risks.statement: Payments of the same amount to the same supplier within seven days, made at different times, may indicate an invoice paid twice; the Rules require written evidence of every purchase [rule:CPR-33].

likelihood.justification: {{$.tests.duplicates.per_tier.different_time.general_procurement.groups}} general-procurement groups were paid at different times [metric:$.tests.duplicates.per_tier.different_time.general_procurement.groups], a clear signal confined to a limited number of suppliers. The Accounts Payable audit gave Reasonable Assurance [history:AUD-02], so no uplift applies.

impact.justification: The value beyond the first payment in those groups is £{{$.tests.duplicates.per_tier.different_time.general_procurement.gbp_beyond_first}} [metric:$.tests.duplicates.per_tier.different_time.general_procurement.gbp_beyond_first], within the Medium financial band of Table 1 [history:$.scoring_method.impact_scale[2]] [rule:CPR-33].

risks.proposed_focus: For each sampled group, obtain both invoices and the purchase orders; confirm they are distinct supplies or that the second payment was recovered.

risks.title: Care and education placements without recorded reasons or board approval
risks.statement: Individually chosen care and education placements are exempt from competition only if the reasons for the choice of provider are recorded, and above the Threshold the contract must be approved by the relevant board [rule:CPR-65] [rule:CPR-66].

likelihood.justification: Placements are the largest tag in the spend, £{{$.population.tags.care_or_education_placement.gbp}} over the window [metric:$.population.tags.care_or_education_placement.gbp], and {{$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[0].placements.windows}} placement windows reach the quote threshold [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[0].placements.windows]; recurring fees can be legitimate, so the base rating is 3. Likelihood is raised by one point for a repeat finding: Personal Budgets (Direct Payments) received Limited Assurance [history:AUD-03].

impact.justification: Placement spend is material and an exemption applied without its records has a reasonable possibility of challenge; external criticism by inspectors is the Medium reputation level of Table 1 [history:$.scoring_method.impact_scale[2]] [rule:CPR-65].

uplift.reason: Limited Assurance on Personal Budgets (Direct Payments), a placement-type purchasing route

evidence: [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[0].placements.windows] placement windows reaching the quote threshold
risks.proposed_focus: For a sample of placement suppliers, inspect case notes for the recorded reasons for the choice of provider and, above the Threshold, the board approval.

risks.title: Key Decision and delegated-authority approvals for awards above the Key Decision threshold
risks.statement: Contract awards above the Key Decision threshold need a Key Decision with a board-approved report, and the largest need Executive approval [rule:CPR-04] [rule:CPR-53] [rule:CPR-54].

likelihood.justification: Auditor override: "Raise likelihood to 3: awards above the Key Decision threshold are rare but carry the highest stakes." The data shows {{$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[1].headline_general_procurement.windows}} general-procurement windows reaching £{{$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[1].threshold}} [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[1].headline_general_procurement.windows]; the approvals themselves are not visible, so the evidence alone supported 2 [rule:CPR-04].

impact.justification: Awards at this level sit in the Major financial band and an award without its Key Decision has a high possibility of legal challenge [history:$.scoring_method.impact_scale[1]] [rule:CPR-53]; the windows total £{{$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[1].headline_general_procurement.gbp}} [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[1].headline_general_procurement.gbp].

evidence: [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.per_threshold[1].headline_general_procurement.windows] general-procurement windows at the Key Decision threshold
risks.proposed_focus: For suppliers whose spend reaches the Key Decision threshold, obtain the Key Decision record, the board-approved report and, where required, the Executive approval.
